bagPolicy.summary: Bring at most one small essentials bag no larger than A4; a clear bag is preferred. Medical and changing bags for babies or small children are exceptions, and there is no left-luggage storage.
allowed: One essentials bag up to A4
Changing bag for baby or young child
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.summary: The on-site Kings Dock Car Park has 1,450 spaces, accessible bays and electric chargers on every level.
parking.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

rideshare.summary: The arena’s visitor and travel pages do not designate an app-based rideshare pickup location.

concessions.summary: Food, drinks and merchandise are sold at the venue; concession payments are contactless only. An event email describes the available food and drink.

ticketPickup.summary: Ticket Quarter box-office collection starts at noon on show day; tickets from other official agents are available from when doors open, if collection was chosen at checkout.

gates.summary: Use the Cityside, Riverside or Floor entry shown on your ticket. The opening time is printed on your ticket and in the pre-event email.
